# Description

My firm ask me to write technical articles fro their blog, one each quarters, as part of my job.

In `00-TA.instruction.md` you find the list of the articles that I have written so far in chronological order from the latest to the earliest.

This is a specification to write a new article to add to this list.

The subject of this article is to describe in a technical but readable way the various Micrsoft IQ offerings, and

1. What the general idea and business case is for the array of Micrsoft IQ offerings  
2. The purpose of each in a brief, but technically thorough, understandable easy-to-read paragraph for each one of the offerings  
3. How each can benefit a business and what its area of application are  
4. How these offering fit together as a whole and how they interplay in a unified business strategy  
5. A summary table where the products can be compared when and where it makes sense
6. Some cost consideration for each of the offerings, also this can be summarized in a table if it makes sense

The `Microsoft-IQs.md` in the folder named `Microsoft-IQs` of this repo list a number of resources 
that I have studied to know more about this subject.
